basic_info.description: NOPA is one of the most loved & coveted neighborhoods in SF with its tree-lined streets, beautiful architecture, central location & access to some of the city's most vibrant commercial areas. Set on a picturesque block in a storied neighborhood, this classic home is a beautiful mix of period Edwardian detailing & modern updates. This stylish home has been thoughtfully renovated with a contemporary floor plan & graced with architectural details, soaring 12' ceilings, elegant millwork & designer finishes throughout. Contemporary open floor plan is spacious yet intimate and the perfect space to entertain both family & friends. Kitchen has been remodeled with ample cabinetry, stone counters, stainless appliances & luxe tile. Large dining area provides space for dinner parties or a quiet night in and spacious living room opens to a private deck. Grand primary bedroom is flooded with light & boasts a beautiful nook, oversized pocket doors & large WI closet. Generous 2nd bedroom w/soaring ceilings & period detail. Remodeled bath features wainscoting & designer tile. This home is just a block to Divisadero with a wide array of world-class shops, restaurants, and cafes. Blocks from GG Park, the Panhandle & Haight Street, this home is perfectly situated for the ultimate urban lifestyle.
